title: Document the versioned planning workflow
description: Update README, wtp help, wtp schema, CHANGELOG, and CONTRIBUTING after behavior is final. Document the nested storage layout, fixed revisable transitions, full planning metadata, global identity/dependency semantics, featureId versus feature, every planning command and exact flags, milestone report hierarchy, case-insensitive AND filters, dry-run and atomic promotion, dependency-closed group rejection, journal recovery order, canonical export layout, branch/shared-store behavior, and compatibility. State explicitly that normal stats, batch, graph, ready, and next exclude planning; rejected replaces deletion; and flat-file is the only backend. Include a complete project/version/milestone example from toplan through promotion and add/update documentation contract tests.
